ValidationRule.description: Prevents Funding users from entering an invalid number of payments when frequency is weekly.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $UserRole.Name = 'Sales Operations', ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Docs Out - MCA'), ISPICKVAL (Docs_Payment_Frequency__c, 'Weekly'), OR( VALUE(ACTUAL_MCA_TERM__c) >80, VALUE(Docs_Term__c) > 80 ) )
